sections.title: Text Box Occlusion
sections.description: Hides the rules text. Works for creatures, instants, sorceries, and sagas.

sections.title: Adventure Cards
sections.description: Cloze 1 occludes the adventure text, Cloze 2 occludes the permanent type.

sections.title: Double-Faced Cards
sections.description: Shows both faces side by side. Cloze 1 occludes the front face, Cloze 2 occludes the back.

sections.title: Split / Room Cards
sections.description: Rotated 90 degrees. Cloze 1 occludes the left half, Cloze 2 occludes the right.

sections.title: Set Symbol Recognition
sections.description: Shows the set icon SVG. The answer is the set name.
